verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents validating cases against a given jurisdiction, filing them, and tracking filings through FinCEN. It also offers configurable narrative templates and case file attachments, so the core of jurisdiction-specific regulatory filing from cases is its own capability. However, the evidence does not describe how a SAR is actually prepared or populated from case evidence, and FinCEN is the only jurisdiction shown. missing for 10: documented SAR form preparation/auto-population from case evidence, evidence of jurisdictions beyond FinCEN, independent or hands-on corroboration.
